title: AutoGoal skip and cancel branches print nothing
current: In the AutoGoal cron path, a busy community lock, a stale due snapshot, an old per-source lock and an already-mapped successor all skip or cancel silently.
evidence: These branches increment summary.skipped and return without logDiagnostic. The cron rule requires an info line with a reason, plus a per-run summary line.
required: info lines with a reason via the #237 cron action helper.
investigate: Count how often a due source is skipped for lock contention (related to R-S7-01).

criticality.why: Delays to the next goal would be invisible, though they self-recover.
